title: Canon state: Aria is badly wounded; the climb must cost her

llm_context.canon: Aria is badly wounded: 5 of 30 hit points after the ghoul fight. Her left side is bandaged but bleeding through. Strenuous exertion should hurt and risk reopening the wound.

canon_facts.fact: Aria is badly wounded (5/30 HP) with a bleeding bandaged side.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I climb the rope out of the pit.

actions.text: Every pull on the rope tears at your wounded side; halfway up, the bandage is wet through and your arms are shaking. You make the lip of the pit gasping, one hand pressed hard against the wound.

actions.question: That climb was brutal on your injured side — roll a Constitution check to avoid reopening the wound.
